stories.title: Health minister under fire over plans to tackle NHS winter pressures
stories.summary: Health minister Mabon ap Gwynfor has faced cross-chamber criticism over NHS funding after setting out his strategy to tackle seasonal winter pressures. stories.title: Plan to cut unnecessary traffic in Chester city centre to be reviewed by councillors next week
stories.summary: A radical rethink in how people travel around Chester is set to be reviewed by council chiefs. stories.title: School leaders in Wales to be balloted for industrial action as pay talks collapse
